source.note: 文本覆盖层：结构/数值/成本/需求以中文主数据为准；技能描述与升级明细英文 wiki 无批量数据，留空并回退中文。

agents.name: Michele
agents.intro: One of P.U.S' new investigators. Dedicated to safeguarding "Utopia."
agents.quote: Stay sharp, the game's not over yet!

weapon.name: Inspector
weapon.desc: Designed for dominating the battlefield, this assault rifle offers a great balance of accuracy and rate of fire. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Pawtector
active.desc: Deploy Pawtectors to automatically attack and slow nearby enemies.

passive.name: Kitty Tracer
passive.desc: Briefly reveal enemies when hit by their direct weapon fire. Gradually regenerate Armor while an active Pawtector is present.

ultimate.name: Mighty Meowblast
ultimate.desc: Deploy a turret to auto-attack nearby enemies.

awakenings.name: Feline Lock
awakenings.desc: Pawtectors' attacks make enemies continuously visible.

awakenings.name: Paw Protector
awakenings.desc: Gain bonus Max Armor while at least one Pawtector is active. When an active Pawtector is destroyed, gain Temporary Armor.

awakenings.name: Whisker Bond
awakenings.desc: Increase your Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability when within 15m of a Pawtector.

agents.name: Nobunaga
agents.intro: A P.U.S captain. He has vowed to protect all of Strinova.
agents.quote: Justice needs no explanation, only action.

weapon.name: Judge
weapon.desc: This automatic rifle uses high-powered rounds for superior combat effectiveness, perfect for all-weather operations. Equipped with a 1.5x scope and switchable between semi-automatic and automatic modes.

active.name: Guardian Eye
active.desc: Deploy a Guardian Eye to boost Rate of Fire, Weapon Usability, and regenerate Armor when in range. Connect Guardian Eyes to enhance these bonuses.

passive.name: Blinding Shot
passive.desc: Charged shots in ADS mode cause enemies to lose weapon accuracy.

ultimate.name: Pulse Overload
ultimate.desc: Deploy a Pulse Device that periodically emits waves, revealing and silencing hit enemies.

awakenings.name: Last Stand
awakenings.desc: Inside the device range, survive one fatal hit and recover some HP and armor.

awakenings.name: Eye of Justice
awakenings.desc: Enemies entering the device's range are continuously revealed.

awakenings.name: Warp Link
awakenings.desc: You can teleport between devices.

items.text: Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability +50%

agents.name: Kokona
agents.intro: One of P.U.S' main operators, and a traveler exploring the very reaches of the world.
agents.quote: Life's greatest satisfactions? Clocking out on time and never missing a meal.

weapon.name: Quasar
weapon.desc: This tactical intervention sniper rifle perfectly combines precision, power, and stealth. Once the longest-range model among Earth's sniper rifles. Equipped with a 2.5x scope.

active.name: Healing Drone
active.desc: Deploy a Healing Drone for yourself or a teammate to restore Armor and heal all nearby allies.

passive.name: First Aid
passive.desc: Slowly regenerate HP when not taking DMG. When assisting an ally, deploy a support drone to automatically rescue them.

ultimate.name: Reconstruction
ultimate.desc: Select a teammate: revive them nearby if downed. If alive, temporarily increase their Rate of Fire, Movement Speed, and Weapon Usability, while decreasing DMG received.

awakenings.name: Rejuvenation
awakenings.desc: When the Drone begins healing an ally, it instantly restores a large amount of HP.

awakenings.name: Armor Surge
awakenings.desc: The Drone restores Armor to all nearby allies.

awakenings.name: Guardian
awakenings.desc: The Drone shields its healing target by absorbing incoming DMG.

agents.name: Yvette
agents.intro: A P.U.S researcher. Best friends with a stuffed bear.
agents.quote: Sorry, I'm just not very good at speaking up, it's not that I don't like you...

weapon.name: Beareas
weapon.desc: A light-weight submachine gun with an unusually high rate of fire and precision compared to most other weapons in its class. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Teddy Assault
active.desc: Summon Fay to charge at enemies, leaving Ice on collision, causing them to slip and become more vulnerable.

passive.name: Camouflage
passive.desc: Stand still to enter camo stealth, becoming visible only as enemies get closer.

ultimate.name: Frostfall
ultimate.desc: Summon a Frost Bear to create Polar Zones, causing enemies to Slip, become Vulnerable, and lowering their Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability.

awakenings.name: Ice Burst
awakenings.desc: Fay explodes upon disappearing, slowing nearby enemies and leaving an icy surface.

awakenings.name: Snowball Fight
awakenings.desc: Fay now throws snowballs that create ice and damage enemies on impact.

awakenings.name: Sentinel Teddy
awakenings.desc: When uncontrolled, Fay detects enemies in range and forms ice on the spot.

agents.name: Flavia
agents.intro: An aggressive and calculating squad leader.
agents.quote: If you can't handle this gentle questioning, who knows what might happen next?

weapon.name: Solo
weapon.desc: A light-weight submachine gun with an unusually high rate of fire and precision compared to most other weapons in its class. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Phantom Mirage
active.desc: While butterflies follow you, taking HP DMG briefly makes you invincible and summons a Phantom Orb at your location. The orb limits enemy vision and can be destroyed.

passive.name: Regenesis
passive.desc: Taking minor DMG reduces your Active Skill CD. Taking major DMG grants temporary Ultimate Points, valid for the current round.

ultimate.name: Phantom Flutter
ultimate.desc: Create a Phantom Zone around you. Within it, fatal enemy attacks trigger a brief invincibility state. Enemies outside can only see you when attacked.

awakenings.name: Fantasy Rebirth
awakenings.desc: After summoning a Phantom Orb, you regenerate HP over time.

awakenings.name: Butterfly Veil
awakenings.desc: Modifies the Active Skill to immediately grant invincibility for a short period, summoning a Phantom Orb at your location.

awakenings.name: Butterfly Armor
awakenings.desc: Turn invisible while in the Active Skill's invincible state. Gain Temporary Armor after leaving the invincible state.

agents.name: Yugiri
agents.intro: A girl with a tragic past and a troubled fate, under the supervision and care of P.U.S.
agents.quote: It costs a lot to send me on assignments.

weapon.name: Retribution
weapon.desc: The standout bullpup rifle, known for its exceptional all-around performance. A classic from old Earth firearms. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Corrosive Mist
active.desc: Deploy a snail device that temporarily erodes nearby enemies' Max Armor on activation. Up to 3 devices can exist at once.

passive.name: Toxin Burst
passive.desc: Dealing DMG to an enemy's HP with firearms creates a toxic mist that deals continuous DMG and temporarily reduces the Max Armor of the target and nearby enemies.

ultimate.name: Venomous Formation
ultimate.desc: Summon a sweeping mist that advances forward, temporarily reducing the Max Armor of enemies in its path.

awakenings.name: Contamination
awakenings.desc: Enemies within the Active Skill's toxic mist have reduced Movement Speed.

awakenings.name: Toxic Expansion
awakenings.desc: Upon activation, the spherical mist gradually expands over time.

awakenings.name: Toxic Cloak
awakenings.desc: The mist turns opaque, blocking vision. Receive an alert when enemies enter the mist. Allies inside the mist continuously restore Armor, and the effect persists even while taking DMG.

agents.name: Leona
agents.intro: The head of P.U.S Engineering, highly meticulous and trustworthy.
agents.quote: I've fixed the last 0.2mm error, and the blueprint is complete! Wait, it's already 3 a.m.?

weapon.name: Calibrator
weapon.desc: Known for its remarkable power and performance, this general-purpose machine gun was a classic sweeper weapon from old Earth's large-scale wars. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Kinetic Barrier
active.desc: Generate square blocks on various surfaces with two angle options. Generating blocks consumes skill points and energy. Blocks can be easily destroyed by Melee Weapons, and a maximum of 16 blocks can exist simultaneously.

passive.name: Work-Life Balance
passive.desc: Continuously restore energy and increase Movement Speed. Armor restores gradually after being stationary for a while.

ultimate.name: Fortress of Purity
ultimate.desc: Fill the energy bar and restore some Active Skill charges. During the skill duration, existing blocks become permanently transparent, no longer blocking paths or ally bullets.

awakenings.name: Energy Dispersion
awakenings.desc: Allies near blocks slowly regenerate Armor and briefly gain Movement Speed when moving away from them.

awakenings.name: Fortified Connection
awakenings.desc: Connected blocks are treated as a single unit with shared HP.

awakenings.name: Prism Blast
awakenings.desc: When blocks are destroyed, they explode, damaging and briefly knocking nearby enemies airborne. This DMG also affects other blocks.

agents.name: Chiyo
agents.intro: A graceful heiress with a charming smile and a fierce archer with decisive skill.
agents.quote: I'm nothing special, just an ordinary girl.

weapon.name: Maple Resonance
weapon.desc: This automatic rifle uses high-powered rounds for superior combat effectiveness, perfect for all-weather operations. Equipped with a 1.5x scope.

active.name: Burst of Brilliance
active.desc: Fire an explosive arrow that sticks to surfaces, which can be detonated early or auto-detonates when its duration ends.

passive.name: Steady Resolve
passive.desc: Steadily regain Focus, with recovery slowing briefly after attacks. When full, Focus is consumed to boost DMG briefly.

ultimate.name: Skyshatter
ultimate.desc: Temporarily reveal enemies near allies and fire a charged wall-piercing explosive arrow at the target. The arrow explodes upon reaching max range or hitting an enemy.

awakenings.name: Withering Pulse
awakenings.desc: Deal enough DMG with your primary weapon and skills to temporarily weaken the target's Armor and healing effects.

awakenings.name: Splinter Bloom
awakenings.desc: Active Skill explodes, splitting into multiple energy fragments that detonate after a delay.

awakenings.name: Blossoming Bait
awakenings.desc: Active Skill now has reduced CD, reduced DMG, increased base stacks, and significantly extended duration. It can be used during the Preparation Phase, revealing and slowing all targets upon hit.

agents.name: Ming
agents.intro: A member of The Scissors and a rebel opposing P.U.S.
agents.quote: Got a problem? Let our fists do the talking.

weapon.name: Rebelflame
weapon.desc: This high-performance, weather-resistant assault rifle delivers powerful firepower and unbeatable value. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Sunder Blast
active.desc: Fire an Electric Orb that detonates on contact or at max range, draining Armor and slowing enemies in range. Can manually detonate early.

passive.name: Aegis Absorb
passive.desc: Firearms or Skills that damage enemy Armor restore your own Armor. Firearms deal extra DMG to Summons.

ultimate.name: Shield Surge
ultimate.desc: Gain Temporary Armor and apply a slow effect with shots. Damage enemy Armor with weapons or skills to extend the skill duration and replenish temporary Armor.

tactical.name: Shock Orb
tactical.desc: Fire a Shock Orb that detonates on command or at max range, stunning and reducing Fire Rate for nearby enemies, with a blurred aim effect.

awakenings.name: Cyclic Rally
awakenings.desc: Losing all Armor briefly boosts Movement Speed. Re-triggering refreshes the duration.

awakenings.name: Static Siphon
awakenings.desc: Initial Sunder Blast hits grant Temporary Armor.

awakenings.name: Volt Charger
awakenings.desc: Charge up while moving or in Electro Field. At full charge, your next hit slows enemies and regenerates your Armor without DMG interruption.

agents.name: Lawine
agents.intro: A member of The Scissors, a blade cutting through deceit.
agents.quote: Someone must uncover the world's truth and harshness.

weapon.name: Shadow Assault
weapon.desc: Short assault rifle with high stability and outstanding accuracy. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Pulse Blade
active.desc: Throw a Pulse Blade to create a magnetic field that reveals enemies within range. Revealing enemies deals Armor DMG and grants a Movement Speed boost.

passive.name: Shadow Reveal
passive.desc: Greatly increases Movement Speed while aiming. Dealing DMG to enemies with weapons briefly reveals them.

ultimate.name: Stealth Master
ultimate.desc: Create a Stealth Zone ahead. Entering the zone grants invisibility and greatly increases Movement Speed. Attacking or interacting briefly reveals your position. Teammates inside the zone also gain a Movement Speed boost. Enemies passing through the zone are briefly revealed.

tactical.name: Shadow Blade
tactical.desc: Throw a Pulse Blade to deal area DMG, blur scopes, and inflict extra DMG on enemy summons.

awakenings.name: Charged Pulse
awakenings.desc: When the Pulse Blade reveals an enemy, it restores your Armor and briefly increases your Armor cap.

awakenings.name: Binding Pulse
awakenings.desc: When the Pulse Wave hits an enemy, it generates an electromagnetic chain and applies a slow effect. The effect persists briefly after the chain disappears.

awakenings.name: Pulse Echo
awakenings.desc: Enemies revealed by the Pulse Blade are scanned again shortly after being revealed. If they are moving, they are briefly revealed again.

agents.name: Meredith
agents.intro: The leader of The Scissors and a scientist pursuing the future of humanity.
agents.quote: Go have fun, I still need to solve the results of the last experiment that defy the Planck constant.

weapon.name: Falcon
weapon.desc: The standout bullpup assault rifle, known for its exceptional all-around performance. A classic from old Earth firearms. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Sandstorm
active.desc: Launch an Energy Orb to create a Sandstorm at the point of impact, temporarily reducing enemy Movement Speed, Weapon Usability, and HP.

passive.name: Zeroth Rings
passive.desc: While airborne, aiming with your Weapons, Skills, or Tactical Items reduces your descent speed.

ultimate.name: Sand Burial
ultimate.desc: Summon a Haboob to obscure vision and temporarily drain enemy HP.

tactical.name: Blinding Sand
tactical.desc: Launch an Energy Orb to create a sandstorm that blocks vision.

awakenings.name: Whirlwind
awakenings.desc: Allies gliding within the sandstorm are lifted upward by a powerful gust.

awakenings.name: Protective Sandstorm
awakenings.desc: Allies within a Sandstorm gain increased Movement Speed and DMG Reduction. These effects are enhanced while Stringified.

awakenings.name: Desert Veil
awakenings.desc: Enemies within the Sandstorm have their field of view greatly reduced.

agents.name: Reiichi
agents.intro: A member of The Scissors. Bathed in darkness, reaching for the light.
agents.quote: If I can lift up the light, I don't mind being the shadow.

weapon.name: Dawn
weapon.desc: This stable and durable marksman rifle offers excellent control. Its specially weighted rounds enhance long-range accuracy. Equipped with a 2.5x scope.

active.name: Daybreak
active.desc: Cast a vertical or horizontal Light Screen to obscure vision.

passive.name: Dawn's Insight
passive.desc: In ADS mode, periodically scan enemies, revealing them briefly only to you.

ultimate.name: Sanctified Shield
ultimate.desc: Instantly refresh Active Skill, enhancing the Light Screen to block all enemy bullets.

tactical.name: Sacred Advancement
tactical.desc: Release a forward-moving transparent, bulletproof Light Screen.

awakenings.name: Sentry Screen
awakenings.desc: Enemies crossing the Light Screen are temporarily exposed.

awakenings.name: Light's Judgment
awakenings.desc: Enemies crossing the Light Screen temporarily lose Max Armor. Allies crossing gain Temporary Armor, triggering once in a short period.

awakenings.name: Chosen Ones
awakenings.desc: The Light Screen turns semi-transparent for nearby allies while remaining opaque to enemies.

agents.name: Kanami
agents.intro: Beloved idol singing the songs of joy.
agents.quote: Take a guess—is my next song about "heartbeat" or "miracle"?

weapon.name: Finale
weapon.desc: Utilizing a short-recoil barrel system, the anti-material sniper rifle delivers astounding power. Equipped with a 2.5x scope.

active.name: Echo Chamber
active.desc: Fire a Sonar Disk to create a detection zone that reveals enemies within its area. On impact, it creates a Sonic Field that briefly reveals enemies inside and deals DMG to summoned units.

passive.name: Echo Reveal
passive.desc: Shots from weapons create a Sonar Zone at their point of impact, damaging and revealing enemies within to you.

ultimate.name: Showtime
ultimate.desc: Summon a holographic figure to play music, pulling in enemies within range and applying Slow, Aim Disruption, Stun, and Fire Rate Reduction effects.

tactical.name: Sonic Trap
tactical.desc: Throw a Mini Speaker to briefly slow enemies entering its range.

awakenings.name: Sonic Blast
awakenings.desc: Enemies within the Sonar Zone created by weapon fire are temporarily slowed, suffer reduced Weapon Usability, and are revealed to all allies.

awakenings.name: Echo Shock
awakenings.desc: Enemies detected by the Sonar Disk get stunned and have reduced Rate of Fire if they remain in range.

awakenings.name: Melodic Boost
awakenings.desc: Allies within the Sonar Disk's range gain increased Movement Speed, Weapon Usability, and Rate of Fire.

agents.name: Eika
agents.intro: An energetic high school student. Adorned in a mask, she protects her home with the power of fire.
agents.quote: Ever imagine a gun in a violin case? That'd be so cool!

weapon.name: Wildfire
weapon.desc: Fully automatic combat shotgun. There's nothing quite like it.

active.name: Purgatory
active.desc: Summon a Flame Cage. While you and enemies are inside, your Primary Weapon inflicts extra Burn DMG. Enemies crossing the cage walls take Burn DMG, with extra DMG when at full Heat and for Stringified enemies. The cage disperses if empty.

passive.name: Sol Battery
passive.desc: Each shot that hits an enemy builds Heat, increasing your Movement Speed based on how much Heat you have. At Max Heat, DMG against Stringified enemies increases. Using a skill automatically consumes all Heat to enhance its effect.

ultimate.name: Firestorm
ultimate.desc: Release a Firestorm to force glide enemies and deal Burn DMG. At max Heat, the storm is larger, deals more DMG, and highlights enemies.

tactical.name: Explosive Fireball
tactical.desc: Throw a fireball that deals extra DMG to stringified enemies. Consume 100 heat for a DMG boost and slowing effect.

awakenings.name: Pyro Strings
awakenings.desc: Enemies stringified within the Flame Cage take Burn DMG.

awakenings.name: Encroaching Cage
awakenings.desc: During Active Skill, the cage radius shrinks until it reaches the minimum size.

awakenings.name: Flame of Life
awakenings.desc: As Heat decreases, it converts to a proportion of HP recovery.

agents.name: Fragrans
agents.intro: A floral expert and master perfumer, she is gentle, charming, and meticulous in life.
agents.quote: A scent? Sorry, I was too close. It's... floral.

weapon.name: Blossom
weapon.desc: Relentless firepower to dominate the battlefield, offering an excellent balance of accuracy and firing rate. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Aroma Surge
active.desc: Release perfume to create an aroma field, boosting allies' Rate of Fire or Movement Speed. The effect fades over time.

passive.name: Elixir Aura
passive.desc: Release a healing aroma to slowly restore HP to yourself and nearby teammates.

ultimate.name: Euphoric Aroma
ultimate.desc: Create a potent aroma field, boosting allies' Rate of Fire, Movement Speed, and HP regeneration without interruption. Can't use weapons during release but gains significant DMG reduction.

tactical.name: Miasma
tactical.desc: Throw a healing perfume that grants allies in the area a temporary Max HP boost and continuous healing, unaffected by DMG.

awakenings.name: Rejuvenate
awakenings.desc: Activating the skill instantly grants nearby allies continuous healing.

awakenings.name: Composite Aroma
awakenings.desc: Activating the skill grants nearby allies a Movement Speed and Rate of Fire bonus, but with reduced duration.

awakenings.name: Eternal Fragrance
awakenings.desc: The Active Skill effect now persists at a lower level after weakening. Switching perfume type changes the ongoing effect.

agents.name: Mara
agents.intro: The sole survivor of the Outbreak incident, she lost dear companions and uncovered secrets that profoundly changed her personality.
agents.quote: Your souls are mine!

weapon.name: Night Scythe
weapon.desc: Mara's signature weapon. A streak of crimson at the end of the barrel resembles the scythe of the Grim Reaper, a harbinger of imminent death.

active.name: Soulbound Prison
active.desc: Cast a phantom hand that generates a Soul Orb when it hits an enemy. The Soul Orb damages and binds nearby targets. Bound enemies can break free by destroying the Soul Orb.

passive.name: Soul Snatcher
passive.desc: Dealing DMG to enemies with weapons or skills heals you. Triggering this effect or applying the Death Mark increases your Movement Speed.

ultimate.name: Grim Reaper
ultimate.desc: Enhances your Passive Skill. Enemies within the marking range are briefly stunned and slowed, revealed to you, and have their minimap continuously obscured. Knocking down a marked target transfers the Death Mark and briefly reveals the remaining targets to you.

tactical.name: Reaper's Creep
tactical.desc: Increases Movement Speed and grants additional DMG Reduction and Stealth when Stringified. Become visible when near enemies.

awakenings.name: Gravity-Bound Soul
awakenings.desc: Enemies bound by the Active Skill have reduced jump speed and height.

awakenings.name: Soul Devourer
awakenings.desc: Hitting enemies with the Active Skill or participating in a kill absorbs their souls, increasing your Movement Speed, Fire Rate, and Weapon Usability. Enemies bound by the Active Skill have their minimap temporarily obscured.

awakenings.name: Soul Form
awakenings.desc: A portion of DMG taken is dealt over time instead. Participating in a knockdown prevents the remaining DMG from being dealt over time. Slowly recover HP after leaving combat.

agents.name: Nora
agents.intro: A specially recruited member of The Scissors, carrying the burden of her family's legacy and pursuing a path toward light.
agents.quote: No matter which path I choose, it is always my own decision.

weapon.name: Rainveil
weapon.desc: A next-generation submachine gun designed for personal defense. Its overwhelming firepower and high operational cost have earned it the nickname "cash sprinkler."

active.name: Shadow Pursuit
active.desc: Summon a spirit that flies to the target area, revealing enemies within range. It will lock onto the closest enemy and strike, dealing DMG and blurring their aim.

passive.name: Void Step
passive.desc: Periodically grants an extra third jump.

ultimate.name: Requiem Hunt
ultimate.desc: Summon numerous shadow clones that pursue enemies within range. When a clone approaches a target, it attacks, dealing DMG and impairing the target's perception.

tactical.name: Void Suppression
tactical.desc: Command a Spirit to fire Dark String energy in a targeted direction, penetrating cover. It explodes on impact or manual activation, dealing DMG and slowing nearby enemies. After a brief charge, it detonates again in a more powerful second explosion.

awakenings.name: Dark String Echo
awakenings.desc: When spirits summoned by the Active Skill are destroyed or disappear, they leave behind residual Dark String energy. Collecting it reduces the cooldown of both Active and Passive Skills.

awakenings.name: Residual String Embers
awakenings.desc: Dark String Missiles fired by spirits detonate and create an erosion field that continuously damages and slows enemies inside it.

awakenings.name: Eye of Omniscience
awakenings.desc: Greatly extend the duration of summoned spirits. While they are active, the Active Skill can be reactivated to take direct control of a spirit, enhancing its attributes during the control period.

agents.name: Audrey
agents.intro: An Urbino merchant of some renown and the head of the Grove family.
agents.quote: Without a doubt, I’m your top choice for a formidable ally.

weapon.name: Champion
weapon.desc: Known for its remarkable power and performance, this general-purpose machine gun was a classic sweeper weapon from old Earth's large-scale wars. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Guns Blazing
active.desc: Enter Deployment Mode. Continuous firing causes the weapon to Overheat. Toggle between 1.25x and 3x zoom.

passive.name: Royal Shield
passive.desc: Generate a frontal shield when entering Deployment or ADS, with extra shield capacity in Deployment Mode.

ultimate.name: Bombardment
ultimate.desc: Fire up to 6 grenades, creating a sea of flames that deals ongoing damage to all enemies in range.

tactical.name: Grenade Turret
tactical.desc: Deploy a Grenade Turret that automatically fires explosive grenades at enemies in sight.

awakenings.name: Field Mobility
awakenings.desc: Allows lateral movement in Deployment Mode.

awakenings.name: Auto Turret
awakenings.desc: While in Deployment Mode, press and hold the Active Skill button to deploy an Autoturret. If the turret is destroyed, it enters a cooldown and cannot be redeployed for a set period.

awakenings.name: Onslaught
awakenings.desc: Rate of Fire gradually increases with continuous shooting. Primary Weapon no longer needs to Reload, but continuous shooting can cause Overheat.

agents.name: Maddelena
agents.intro: A sunny and cheerful artist who always seems to end up in the middle of one trouble or another.
agents.quote: Time to head out! I wonder what new adventures await today?

weapon.name: Chroma
weapon.desc: Balancing power and range perfectly, the marksman rifle excels at suppressing mid-to-long-distance targets. Comes equipped with a 1.5x scope.

active.name: Pigment Bind
active.desc: Fire paint to String-Block, slow, and reveal footprints of enemies in range.

passive.name: Paint Tracks
passive.desc: Primary Weapon hits slow enemies and reveal their tracks.

ultimate.name: Paint Bubble
ultimate.desc: Fire a giant bubble that String-Blocks and reveals tracks of enemies inside. When it bursts, it slows and makes enemies in the area vulnerable.

tactical.name: Paint Bucket
tactical.desc: Launch forward-moving paint bubbles that block enemy bullets and slow, string-block nearby enemies. Bubbles burst when taking maximum DMG.

awakenings.name: Wall Whisper
awakenings.desc: Teammates wall-sticking in painted areas will conceal themselves, greatly boost Movement Speed, and slowly heal.

awakenings.name: Painter's Trail
awakenings.desc: Fires paint that forms a trailing line, creating additional paint zones.

awakenings.name: Dyeblast
awakenings.desc: A bubble forms in the painted area to block vision; it explodes on contact, applying a paint debuff to enemies.

agents.name: Fuchsia
agents.intro: The honed blade of Urbino, and a hardened killer seeking for a home.
agents.quote: Don't call me in the morning. Waking up on the wrong side makes me dangerous.

weapon.name: Sawtooth
weapon.desc: Balancing power and stability, this battle rifle is a fine example of Earth's industrial craftsmanship. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Apex Predator
active.desc: Detect nearby enemies; full HP targets appear briefly, while those with less HP remain visible longer, all only visible to you. Detecting them boosts your Movement Speed and increases DMG to those enemies.

passive.name: Hunter's Feast
passive.desc: Generate Energy Crystals by participating in kills or dealing HP DMG with weapons. Absorb them to restore HP and temporarily increase Max HP. Damage-based Crystal generation has a cooldown.

ultimate.name: Bloodbath
ultimate.desc: Greatly boost your Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability, highlighting enemies within your Active Skill's vision. Absorbing Energy Crystals extends this effect's duration.

tactical.name: Crimson Rush
tactical.desc: Consume a small amount of HP for a brief Movement Speed boost, gradually restoring the lost HP after the boost ends.

awakenings.name: Gluttony
awakenings.desc: Crystal absorption range extends to the entire map.

awakenings.name: Second Wind
awakenings.desc: While knocked down, Max HP is increased, and you will automatically recover after a short duration.

awakenings.name: Terror Hunter
awakenings.desc: Active skill briefly slows enemies in range.

agents.name: Celestia
agents.intro: The founder of the Astral Sanctuary. A gentle girl dedicated to building a peaceful world.
agents.quote: Make sure to drop by Astral Sanctuary for a quick check-up.

weapon.name: Polaris
weapon.desc: Built for sustained use with excellent heat dissipation, this assault rifle provides precise accuracy for close-range shots, with a smooth trigger pull and ambidextrous comfort. Equipped with a 1.25x scope and switchable between automatic and burst modes.

active.name: Guardian Star
active.desc: Grants Temporary Armor on a selected teammate and yourself. The skill automatically targets you when there are no teammates in sight.

passive.name: Cosmic Recovery
passive.desc: Continuously restore Armor for yourself and nearby allies.

ultimate.name: Astral Gate
ultimate.desc: Select a teammate to give both of you Temporary Armor and start charging. Teleport to them when fully charged.

tactical.name: Starburst
tactical.desc: Throw a Starflare to create an Armor recovery zone, granting allies Temporary Armor and continuous Armor regeneration inside. This effect isn't interrupted by DMG.

awakenings.name: Comet Bracers
awakenings.desc: Active Skill gains Temporary Armor regeneration, immune to DMG interruptions.

awakenings.name: Starlight
awakenings.desc: When the Armor from the Active Skill is breached, it releases starlight that blinds enemies.

awakenings.name: Astral Armor
awakenings.desc: Active Skill instantly restores some Armor.

agents.name: Bai Mo
agents.intro: Though now a high-up of Urbino, there's nothing this street youth values more than freedom.
agents.quote: Even the biggest crisis can wait until the party's over!

weapon.name: Freedom Reign
weapon.desc: A highly reliable and durable semi-automatic featuring ghost ring iron sights for improved accuracy. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Blitz Waltz
active.desc: Dash forward and reload your shotgun. Primary weapon hits reduce cooldown.

passive.name: Nimble Stride
passive.desc: Briefly boosts Movement Speed when using an Active Skill, taking weapon or throwable DMG, or dodging bullets through Stringify.

ultimate.name: Streetfighter
ultimate.desc: Place a Beacon to Respawn instantly if downed or killed. Press the skill key again to return to the Beacon.

tactical.name: Explosive Graffiti
tactical.desc: Throw an Explosive Paint Can that slows, stuns, and reduces the Fire Rate of nearby enemies.

awakenings.name: Tempo Shift
awakenings.desc: After using an Active Skill, Armor gradually restores without interruption from taking DMG.

awakenings.name: Ink Charge
awakenings.desc: Using the Active Skill grants extra DMG reduction and splashes paint at the landing point, briefly obscuring nearby enemies' vision.

awakenings.name: Trickster
awakenings.desc: Briefly enter stealth during Active Skill, leaving a decoy at the starting point.

agents.name: Galatea
agents.intro: A renowned magician and a mad artist hiding behind her glamor.
agents.quote: This is boring. What should we do next?

weapon.name: Gambit
weapon.desc: This high-performance, weather-resistant assault rifle delivers powerful firepower and unbeatable value. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Wild Card
active.desc: Throw a card to create a decoy on impact or by pressing the skill button again. Press the interact key to teleport to the decoy.

passive.name: Deception
passive.desc: When leaving a wall, leave a decoy behind. If you take firearm DMG or the decoy takes DMG, the effect enters cooldown. All decoys briefly reveal nearby enemies upon creation, and enemies that attack a decoy will have their position exposed.

ultimate.name: Mirage
ultimate.desc: Throw cards forward to create multiple teleportation decoys in different positions. While throwing the cards, you become invisible and gain increased Movement Speed.

tactical.name: Blinding Shadow
tactical.desc: Summon a decoy that cannot be teleported to. If destroyed, it blinds all nearby enemies.

awakenings.name: Illusionary Strike
awakenings.desc: Gain Temporary Armor and briefly boost Weapon Usability upon teleporting.

awakenings.name: Snap
awakenings.desc: Teleport to trigger 3 seconds of stealth, increasing Movement Speed and holstering your weapon.

awakenings.name: Castling
awakenings.desc: Leave a decoy at your original location after teleporting.

agents.name: Cielle
agents.intro: A girl with lost memories, currently a Bounty Hunter settled in Urbino.
agents.quote: Relax, boss—if the pay's real, so is my loyalty.

weapon.name: Surfbreak
weapon.desc: Lever-action shotgun with high reliability and durability. Deals massive damage at close range. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

active.name: Mobile Shield
active.desc: Deploys an energy shield to block DMG. Cielle can charge forward while the shield is active. Cielle's armor is restored when the shield takes DMG. The shield will gradually repair after being deactivated. Sniper rifles deal extra DMG to the shield.

passive.name: Auto Chamber
passive.desc: After briefly holstering your weapon, it automatically reloads. Quickly switch to your weapon right after a shield charge or manual detonation.

ultimate.name: Absolute Defense
ultimate.desc: Reinforces and refreshes the energy shield, increasing shield HP, reducing charge cooldown, and enhancing charge effects.

tactical.name: Graviton Bind
tactical.desc: Throw a destructible gravity orb that pulls enemies to its center, deals DMG on landing, and inflicts extra DMG to enemy summons.

awakenings.name: Momentum Surge
awakenings.desc: Gain a brief Movement Speed boost after a charge, manual shield detonation, or using a Tactical Skill.

awakenings.name: Bulwark Buster
awakenings.desc: While holding the shield, hold right-click to detonate it, dealing DMG to enemies in front. Grants Temporary Armor and restores part of the shield's CD.

awakenings.name: Unified Guard
awakenings.desc: While the shield is raised, all incoming DMG is absorbed by the shield, with extra DMG applied to it.
